items.title: Doc convention: xem lib/utils.ts, data/profile.ts, components/ui/button.tsx da tao o task project-scaffold de bam sat pattern
items.notes: Pattern da xac dinh o project-scaffold: cn() tu @/lib/utils, du lieu tu @/data/profile (heroTechStack), Button tu @/components/ui/button (variant/size/asChild), CSS var tokens (--color-primary, --color-accent...) dung duoc truc tiep trong Tailwind class (bg-primary, text-accent...).

items.title: Tao Hero3DCanvas: R3F Canvas wrapper, dynamic import ssr:false, detect WebGL + prefers-reduced-motion
items.notes: Se lam trong item tiep: Hero3DCanvas la loader/canvas wrapper, ban tao truoc TechCardsScene la scene noi dung.

items.title: Tao TechCardsScene: rotating tech-cards 3D tu heroTechStack (Q1 = huong C)
items.notes: TechCardsScene: 12 the (heroHighlightTech) xep vong tron ban kinh 3.2, Float cho hieu ung bap benh nhe, auto-rotate group qua useFrame (tat khi reducedMotion), OrbitControls gioi han goc/zoom, khong pan.

items.title: Tao StaticFallback: anh/illustration tinh khi khong ho tro WebGL hoac reduced-motion
items.notes: StaticFallback: server-renderable grid 9 tech badge (subset heroHighlightTech), role=img + aria-label mo ta, khong canvas/motion.

items.title: Tao HeroSection: layout text (h1/h2) + CTA buttons + Hero3DCanvas, dam bao text server-rendered doc lap voi canvas
items.notes: HeroSection la Server Component (khong use client): h1/h2/CTA la HTML that, render server-side, doc lap voi Hero3DCanvasLoader (client, lazy). Them Download CV CTA - da copy file CV goc that vao public/cv-nguyen-van-truong.pdf nen link hoat dong ngay.

items.title: Wire HeroSection vao page.tsx thay placeholder scaffold
items.notes: page.tsx thay placeholder scaffold bang HeroSection that.

items.title: Non-functional: responsive (giam scene/poly tren mobile)
items.notes: Layout flex-col tren mobile (lg:flex-row tren desktop), canvas w-full max-w-md tu co giao. DPR cap giam xuong [1,1.5] de tiet kiem GPU tren thiet bi mobile/tam trung.

items.title: Non-functional: a11y (aria-hidden canvas, text that song song, reduced-motion)
items.notes: Canvas wrapper co aria-hidden=true; h1/h2/CTA la text that ben ngoai canvas, khong phu thuoc 3D. reducedMotion=true -> render StaticFallback (khong canvas, khong animation) thay vi chi tat auto-rotate, dam bao tuan thu tuyet doi prefers-reduced-motion.

items.title: Non-functional: performance (limit DPR, dispose on unmount, lazy-load)
items.notes: dpr cap [1,1.5], frameloop=demand (chi render khi invalidate() duoc goi, khong render loop lien tuc), Suspense loading skeleton, next/dynamic ssr:false lazy-load toan bo three.js code khoi bundle chinh, R3F auto-dispose geometry/material khi unmount (mac dinh, khong override dispose=null).

items.title: Chay lint + typecheck + build de verify
items.notes: typecheck: pass. lint: pass sau khi fix 2 loi react-hooks/set-state-in-effect (chuyen sang useSyncExternalStore cho reducedMotion, lazy useState init cho webglSupported vi component chi mount client-side qua ssr:false). next build: pass. dev server: GET / tra 200, HTML SSR chua h1=Nguyen Van Truong that, CTA View Work/Download CV render server-side, xac nhan khong phu thuoc canvas mount.
